sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:46

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:46:1
items.html: Netzah, and it drew the five Hassadim into the body of Israel Saba: As written above with regard to AVI, that the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of ZON draw nothing but Hesed and Gevura. See there. And so it is here, for those same MAN that were in the upper AVI subsequently descended to the discernment of the coupling of YESHSUT. And it has already been explained that the discernment of the ten Sefirot of Guf that expand from the body of Israel Saba come in the king of Netzah.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:46:2
items.html: Both of them are only one king: For both of them came out from the discernment of the body of YESHSUT, that is, from the screen of phase two, as above. And therefore they are one level and one king.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:46:3
items.html: The posterior of Tevuna descended as well, and Israel Saba and Tevuna returned back to back: For when the kings of NH died, the screen refined from phase two to phase one and the bottom Hey returned to the Einayim, and then they returned back to back, that is, to the discernments of the posterior of the upper Ima, in order to protect the lack of GAR that is in them, as above.
